import csv, glob, os
# For several assets, show closes over last 20 trading days before 2035-11-07
assets=['SPX','NDX','N225','SOX','SX5E','000300.SH','000688.SH','HSI','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
import os
for a in assets:
    p=f'../persistent/stock_data/{a}.csv'
    if not os.path.exists(p):
        print(a,'NO FILE'); continue
    rows=list(csv.reader(open(p)))
    # find index of 2035-11-07
    idx=None
    for i,r in enumerate(rows[1:],1):
        if r[0]=='2035-11-07': idx=i; break
    if idx is None:
        print(a,'no 2035-11-07'); continue
    window=rows[max(1,idx-20):idx+1]
    closes=[round(float(r[2]),1) for r in window]
    ret60=round((closes[-1]/closes[-2]-1)*100,2) if len(closes)>1 else None
    ret20=round((closes[-1]/closes[-21]-1)*100,2) if len(closes)>20 else None
    print(f'{a}: last={closes[-1]} d1={ret60}% d20={ret20}%')
"
